extracted.name: Miso & ginger prawn noodle salad
extracted.description: Enjoy a prawn noodle salad for a quick and easy dinner. With punchy miso and ginger flavours, it’s low in fat and calories and takes just 15 minutes to make
ingredient_lines: 1 carrot peeled into ribbons using a vegetable peeler
½ cucumber deseeded, halved and thinly sliced into half-moons
100g sugar snap peas halved if you like
1 red chilli sliced (deseeded if you prefer less heat)
300g peeled and cooked jumbo king prawns
instruction_lines: Cook the noodles following pack instructions, adding the edamame for the last 2-3 mins of the cooking time. Drain in a colander, rinse with cold running water, and drain again. Tip the noodles and edamame into a bowl with the sesame oil and toss to prevent sticking. Leave to cool.

Meanwhile, tip all the dressing ingredients into a lidded jar, seal and shake well to combine. Toss the cooled noodles and edamame with the remaining ingredients and the dressing, and serve immediately.
